_comment: NEURONSHOW probe station (infra/vast/operations/2026-10-26_neuronshow_path.md): one rental that stays up while requests arrive and ends itself 30 min after the last one (cells/probe_station.py), then banks every request and response and is destroyed by lifecycle.sh. Laptop client: infra/vast/probe.py (one ssh command per probe). The server starts as the echo stand-in; the real server (infra/pg/probe_server.py) is started on the live box with `probe.py deploy --ref <commit> --server '<cmd>'`, or by renting with this cell's server set to its command. GPU >= 40 GB for the three models at once (Q4B + G4 + O7 bf16 = about 31 GB); L40S preferred, but on 2026-10-27 every L40S and RTX 6000 Ada offer failed the README base filter (bandwidth charge, CUDA < 13.0 driver or < 800 Mb/s), so such an offer is rented by explicit id (controller rent does not re-apply the filter). cuda_vers>=13.0 because mdl-v1 is torch 2.12.0+cu130. Weights from the Hub by the server (HF_ONLINE=1, HF_TOKEN shipped by controller.py from SSM). max_billed_h 6 is the per-session ceiling and keeps a session inside budget.json's remaining headroom; load_backstop_min 30 as the other vast manifests.
